title.en: Ocean View Villa in Playa del Carmen

description.es: Espectacular villa de tres recámaras a solo 200 metros de la playa. Cuenta con alberca privada, cocina integral con acabados de mármol y una terraza con vista panorámica al Caribe. Ideal para inversión de renta vacacional o residencia de descanso.
description.en: Spectacular three-bedroom villa just 200 meters from the beach. Features a private pool, a fully integrated marble-finish kitchen, and a terrace with panoramic Caribbean views. Ideal for vacation rental investment or a leisure residence.

address.es: Zona Costera Norte, Playa del Carmen, Quintana Roo
address.en: North Coastal Zone, Playa del Carmen, Quintana Roo
